summary: Stage read-only normal-update policy admission file checks without adding an active controller.

schema.detail: No active database or policy format change; reuse the existing staged policy schema.

rules.detail: No active scheduler or permission boundary changes. Native decision authenticity remains outside the unused reader.

compatibility.detail: No client, server or wire behavior changes. No serving compatibility or physical acceptance is inferred.

downtime.detail: No service or device changes; no active caller, installation, launch or scheduler is added.

manual.detail: No operator action is required for this inert source component. Any future activation requires its own reviewed exact policy.

recovery.detail: No active recovery change. The reader cannot create, repair or append to the revocation file.
